query: What is the minimum CGPA required to graduate with First Class with Distinction?
answer_preview:
**Academic Regulations § 10.1** (§ 10.1 First Class with Distinction and Dean's List) stipulates:

> "A candidate who secures a final CGPA of 8.50 and above, without having failed in any course throughout the entire dura...
full_answer:
**Academic Regulations § 10.1** (§ 10.1 First Class with Distinction and Dean's List) stipulates:

> "A candidate who secures a final CGPA of 8.50 and above, without having failed in any course throughout the entire duration of the programme, shall be declared to have passed in **"First Class with Distinction"**."

Additionally: **Dean’s Merit List:** Students securing an SGPA of 9.00 and above in any semester with zero backlog courses are placed on the "Dean’s Academic Merit Honor Roll" and awarded a formal commendation certificate at the Annual Convocation ceremony.
